TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort
TABLE.COMMENT: Advanced cohorts (curated and rule-based) - extends cohort records with component tool_mucohort

FIELD.NAME: cohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: Relevant cohort id where component is set to tool_mucohort

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Cohort type: curated or rules

FIELD.NAME: candidatecohortid
FIELD.COMMENT: Limits adding of new members only (manually, uploads or rules), never causes removals; does not apply to forced users; a deleted cohort blocks new additions

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_access
TABLE.COMMENT: Explicit per-cohort access, changed only by users with capabilities; any record allows finding and using the cohort

FIELD.NAME: iscurator
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 marks the one person shown as responsible for the cohort, NULL otherwise; honorary title that does not grant any permissions automatically, the curator may receive notifications

FIELD.NAME: viewmembers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means user may list members and explain membership; implied by managemembers and manageexceptions

FIELD.NAME: managemembers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means user may add and remove members of curated cohorts, within the limits of candidates and forced/blocked users

FIELD.NAME: manageexceptions
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means user may manage forced and blocked users; all flags 0 means the user may only find and use the cohort, for example in enrolment methods

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: User who made the last change, NULL if unknown or deleted

INDEX.NAME: mucohortid-iscurator
INDEX.COMMENT: Only one curator per cohort, NULL values are not unique

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_exception
TABLE.COMMENT: Exceptions: users that are always (forced) or never (blocked) members of the cohort, use only in exceptional cases or during cohort type migration

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means forced - always member; 2 means blocked - never member, existing membership is removed

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional plain text reason entered by the person who added the exception, shown only to users who may manage exceptions; cleared on privacy deletion

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: User who made the last change, NULL if unknown or deleted

INDEX.NAME: mucohortid-userid
INDEX.COMMENT: User cannot be both forced and blocked

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_role
TABLE.COMMENT: Roles automatically assigned to cohort members, assignments use component tool_mucohort and itemid of this record

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Context where role is assigned to members, such as system or category, NULL means the cohort context which follows the cohort when it is moved

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who added the record, NULL if unknown or deleted

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_curated
TABLE.COMMENT: Settings of curated cohorts, created and deleted together with conversion to and from curated type

FIELD.NAME: maxmembers
FIELD.COMMENT: Limits all additions of new members, never causes removals; forced users are exempt (deliberate overbooking); NULL means no limit

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_rules
TABLE.COMMENT: Rules and sync settings of rule-based cohorts

FIELD.NAME: broken
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means rules could not be evaluated (missing cohort or source), sync is skipped until fixed; reason is shown by re-parsing the rules

FIELD.NAME: rulesjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Active rules, NULL means no rules were approved yet and sync is inactive; sync runs when not NULL and not broken

FIELD.NAME: pendingrulesjson
FIELD.COMMENT: Draft rules waiting for approval via preview, NULL if there is no draft

FIELD.NAME: synctype
FIELD.COMMENT: How sync changes membership: 0 no changes, 1 add and remove members, 2 add members only (blocked users and users of other tenants are still removed); applies from the next sync

FIELD.NAME: syncinterval
FIELD.COMMENT: Automatic sync interval in seconds, NULL means manual sync only

FIELD.NAME: syncpriority
FIELD.COMMENT: Sync priority bucket: 0 high, 1 normal, 2 low; high cohorts sync first, then normal, then low, order within a bucket is not defined

FIELD.NAME: synconusercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means membership of user is evaluated instantly after manual creation of a single account, not in bulk operations

FIELD.NAME: synconfirstlogin
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means membership of user is evaluated instantly on first login

FIELD.NAME: synconlogin
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means membership of user is evaluated instantly on every login

FIELD.NAME: timenextsync
FIELD.COMMENT: When the next sync is due, 0 means as soon as possible, NULL means not scheduled

INDEX.NAME: timenextsync
INDEX.COMMENT: Lookup of cohorts due for sync

INDEX.NAME: synconusercreated
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup after user creation, only few cohorts have it enabled

INDEX.NAME: synconfirstlogin
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup on login, only few cohorts have it enabled

INDEX.NAME: synconlogin
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup on login, only few cohorts have it enabled

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_sync
TABLE.COMMENT: History of all sync runs of rule-based cohorts for tracking duration and changes over time, purged after configurable retention period

FIELD.NAME: timequeued
FIELD.COMMENT: When the sync was requested, the adhoc task carries this record id

FIELD.NAME: timestarted
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL while queued

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Duration in seconds, NULL while running

FIELD.NAME: added
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of members added

FIELD.NAME: removed
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of members removed

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 running, 1 ok, 2 failed, 3 rejected (empty external result), 4 broken (rules cannot be evaluated), 5 cancelled, 6 queued, 7 cancel requested; row is inserted as queued, set to running at start, so crashed syncs remain visible

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Error or other details

INDEX.NAME: mucohortid-timequeued
INDEX.COMMENT: Latest sync is unambiguous, second sync queued in the same second fails on insert

INDEX.NAME: timequeued
INDEX.COMMENT: Site report time filters and retention purge

INDEX.NAME: duration
INDEX.COMMENT: Site report filtering and sorting of slow syncs

INDEX.NAME: status
INDEX.COMMENT: Finding the few queued and running syncs on the site

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_profilefield
TABLE.COMMENT: Cache of custom profile field values of supported types for fast rule evaluation, ignores field visibility

FIELD.NAME: charvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Value of text-like fields, truncated to 255 characters

FIELD.NAME: intvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Value of checkbox and datetime fields

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_extdb
TABLE.COMMENT: External database sources of rule-based cohorts, each query may be used only once per cohort

FIELD.NAME: queryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin defined external database query

FIELD.NAME: timefirstcompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: End time of the first successful fetch, never changed afterwards; NULL means rules using this source cannot be approved and are broken

FIELD.NAME: timefetchstarted
FIELD.COMMENT: Start time of the last fetch attempt as max(now, previous value + 1) so it is unique; sweep is done only if unchanged at the end of fetch; NULL if never fetched

FIELD.NAME: fetchduration
FIELD.COMMENT: Duration of the last fetch attempt in seconds

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: State of the last fetch attempt using the shared sync status codes, only 0 running, 1 ok, 2 failed, 3 rejected (empty external result) are used here; NULL if never fetched; does not block cohort sync because the snapshot never loses rows outside a successful sweep

FIELD.NAME: usercreated
FIELD.COMMENT: User who added the source, NULL if unknown or deleted

TABLE.NAME: tool_mucohort_extdb_user
TABLE.COMMENT: Local snapshot of users returned by external database source

FIELD.NAME: identifiertype
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the external query result column the identifier came from: userid, username, useremail or useridnumber; stored per row so that identifiers may be coalesced from several columns in the future

FIELD.NAME: useridentifier
FIELD.COMMENT: Raw user identifier value from external database, kept so that unmatched rows can be shown

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Matched user, resolved again on every fetch; NULL if not matched or ambiguous (matches multiple users); only users from the cohort tenant and users without tenant are matched

FIELD.NAME: stale
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 means the row was not received yet in the current fetch; all rows set to 1 at fetch start, received rows set to 0, rows still 1 deleted after a successful fetch; sweep only when tool_mucohort_extdb.timefetchstarted still matches the fetch; rules must ignore this flag

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the row first appeared in external database

INDEX.NAME: extdbid-identifiertype-useridentifier
INDEX.COMMENT: Duplicate rows from external database are collapsed
